newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila futures market says approves new members.
newsitem.headline: Manila futures market says approves new members.

text.p: The Manila International Futures Exchange Inc (MIFE), where trading is suspended following reports of widespread irregularities, said on Monday it had approved the membership of 18 businessmen seeking to establish commodity futures brokerages.
In a statement, MIFE said it had also hired a new management team to oversee the operations of the exchange and implement reforms.

The Philippine Securities and Exchange Commission halted MIFE operations in June and said that it needed a range of reforms and at least 10 licensed commodity futures brokers before it would be allowed to resume trading.
The exchange offered futures contracts in copra, dry cocoon, soybeans, coffee and major currencies but trading volumes were negligible.
